parsed.summary: The proposed patch introduces a non-minimal change and has potential maintainability issues.

issues.description: The patch creates an empty `__init__.py` file for every directory, which is not a minimal change and may have unintended side effects on other parts of the codebase.
The patch introduces a complex and potentially fragile approach by creating files on the fly, which can lead to maintainability issues and unexpected behavior.
